title: Reports reach the owning repo
description: A finding is filed on the repo that owns the code the finding is about: Stravica/rcf-lite for shelf blueprints and core, and the library-declared repo for library blueprints. Library owners declare their destination via an optional issues field on library.json; the consuming project does not guess. Applied blueprints without a declared destination fall back to derivation from the library git source when unambiguous, else route to the outbox and name the library publisher contact. Doctor lists any registered library missing a destination as a warn-only finding.
